task_completion.description: OpenBCI GUI is launched and the playback file is selected.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenBCI GUI window is visible, and the playback source shows 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-MotorImagery.txt' or the session has started with this data.

task_completion.description: Odd-numbered channels (1, 3, 5, 7) are activated/visible in the Time Series widget.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Time Series widget, the toggle buttons or signal traces for channels 1, 3, 5, and 7 are clearly active/on.

task_completion.description: Even-numbered channels (2, 4, 6, 8) are deactivated/hidden in the Time Series widget.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Time Series widget, the toggle buttons or signal traces for channels 2, 4, 6, and 8 are clearly greyed out, turned off, or hidden from view.

task_completion.description: The time series display window is set to 10 seconds.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Window' setting in the Time Series widget or the X-axis of the graph shows a duration of 10 seconds.

task_completion.description: A screenshot of the final configuration is saved to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager window or terminal output confirms the creation of '~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots/left_hemi_montage.png' showing the configured GUI.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the GUI elements rather than just using terminal commands to move files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor over GUI buttons (like channel toggles or window settings) or menus being opened within the OpenBCI application.

integrity.description: The data displayed in the GUI matches the expected playback file content, not a static image.
integrity.visual_evidence: The EEG signal traces show active waveforms consistent with the S001 Motor Imagery recording rather than a flat line or placeholder.

integrity.description: The screenshot was generated by the GUI's internal screenshot function or a system screenshot of the active GUI, not by renaming an existing file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The saved image 'left_hemi_montage.png' contains the actual OpenBCI GUI interface with the specific channel and window settings applied.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task is successful if: 1) The file 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-MotorImagery.txt' is loaded. 2) In the Time Series widget, channels 1, 3, 5, and 7 are ON, while channels 2, 4, 6, and 8 are OFF. 3) The horizontal time scale (Window) is set to 10s. 4) The final state is captured in a screenshot named 'left_hemi_montage.png' in the specified directory.
